220080101.text: Doudou, be a good girl, you'll only get better if you take your medicine...

220080102.text: No! I don't want to! I hate it, it tastes gross...

220080104.text: Oh, hello Traveler. Doudou is quite a sickly child. This is the medicine she needs to take, according to the prescription Dr. Baizhu gave me.

220080105.text: But she refuses to take it. She complains she doesn't like the taste... *sigh* Unfortunately, herbal medicine is bitter, that's just how it is...

220080106.text: The only time she ever agrees to take it is if she gets to have a bowl of Almond Tofu afterwards.

220080107.text: Traveler, if you have the time, could you go and pick me up a portion of Almond Tofu? I should stay here — I may still need to talk her into it...

220080109.text: Thank you. Just one portion for Doudou is enough.

220080111.text: *sigh* I wish I knew. Whatever it is, Dr. Baizhu says it's nearly impossible to cure, and that just keeping the symptoms at bay takes a lot of medication.

220080112.text: I fear she might need to take medicine her whole life. And starting at such a young age... It doesn't bear thinking about.

220080113.text: I just wish I were the one with the illness... But the best I can hope for is that things don't get any worse for the poor child.

220080114.text: Anyway. Please go and fetch me a portion of Almond Tofu, just the one will do.

220080116.text: It's sooooo bitter!!! Lulu's medicine is way less bitter than mine!

220080117.text: Doudou... Lulu and her friends were just pretending. That wasn't real medicine they were drinking, it was some leftover sugary water from a bowl of Almond Tofu.

220080118.text: Oh... So Almond Tofu won't make me get better? Then... I guess I do have to take that icky medicine...

220080119.text: That's right! Good girl. As soon as you're better you can eat whatever you like!

220080120.text: Why can't they make medicine taste sweet like Almond Tofu? So unfair...

220080121.text: *sigh* There's no getting through to her... Anyway. Please go and fetch me a portion of Almond Tofu, just the one will do.

220080405.text: Wah... But, Mr. Baizhu is so clever... why can't he make the medicine Almond Tofu flavor...
